newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VIALLI BACKS SICK KANU FOR GOLDEN BALL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VIALLI BACKS SICK KANU FOR GOLDEN BALL.

text.p: Gianluca Vialli wants this year's Golden Ball award to go to Nigeria's Olympic gold medallist Nwankwo Kanu whose football career is under threat because of a heart problem.
Vialli, who plays for English premier league club Chelsea, made his appeal on Tuesday on Italian pay-tv sports channel Telepiu2.
"It would be the best way to let this Nigerian star know that the whole world of soccer is behind him," Vialli said.
"It's a deserved award anyway for a player who is as great as he is unlucky."
The honour is one of the most prestigious individual soccer accolades in Europe. It was opened last year to non-European players when it was won by AC Milan's Liberian striker George Weah.
Kanu, 20, moved this summer from Ajax Amsterdam to Internazionale of Milan where post-Olympic medical tests showed up a "valvular insufficiency of the aorta".
Doctors say the heart problem means Kanu may never play again.
